title: Khmer NLP: Text Classification for Low-Resource Languages
description: This project develops natural language processing models for Khmer text classification, addressing the challenge of limited labeled data for low-resource languages. The team applies transfer learning and data augmentation techniques.
investigators: Dr. Sothea Has, Dr. Sokkhey Phauk

title: Predictive Analytics for Rice Yield Estimation in Cambodia
description: Using satellite imagery, IoT sensor data, and machine learning to predict rice yields across Cambodian provinces. Results will inform agricultural policy and food security planning.
partner: Ministry of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries

title: Smart Energy Monitoring System for University Buildings
description: Designing and deploying IoT-based energy monitoring systems across ITC campus buildings to reduce energy consumption and promote sustainable campus operations.
partner: Smart Axiata, Ministry of Mines and Energy
